card.fires_on: The word just before "manager" or "managers", such as "project" or "cluster" in "The project manager", or the start of "managers" itself. It also fires near Johnson/LBJ text.

modes.label: Noun before manager
modes.description: A role or system word that is followed by "manager" in a job or software title.

modes.description: The first piece of the word "managers" in a list of staff roles.

modes.label: Johnson context
modes.description: Words near a mention of Lyndon Johnson, where the next word may be a name like Johnson.
